style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Purposefully constructed soft cyan collector, recessed guarded mouth and warm protective lip, visibly seated on its actual finite mount, with readable subtle native pulse/rock loop in every facing.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: The collector looks purposefully built: softened substantial cyan shell/rim, visibly recessed mouth, guards with rounded volume and a protective yellow base. The large empty cyan plate of the source becomes resolved native construction. Rear and side views are coherent finished parts, with no unresolved broad blank slab, detached guard tips, exposed construction ends or implausible junctions.
priorityOutcomes.proof: All four registered native idle images enlarged and at192x352 logical size, plus actual mounted neutral all four views under main65degree camera. Native finite rear-seat proof is separate from visible contact.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Warm gentle gradients reveal cyan enamel, gray structural metal, dark recess and yellow protective base as distinct volumes. Broad restrained reflections remain coherent through cardinal rotations, without a preferred horizontal light direction, white featureless plates, black dead spots, harsh narrow gloss strips, muddy merged guards, halos, or directional ground shadows. Purposeful details support the broad hierarchy and remain optional when they vanish at phone scale.
priorityOutcomes.proof: Exact native images on light/gray/dark backgrounds, registered all-four sheet and native mounted contexts; no per-view recoloring or post-render repair.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Idle reads as neutral; active reads as a small functional mouth pulse with rocking guards over a clean one-second loop. Native construction, pivots and numeric amplitude may improve this same gesture. The action must be perceptible in all four standalone facings at intended logical and phone sizes, including N where source tips barely move. Preserve12fps,12runtime frames and true closing key13, with nonnegative ground sweep. No added2D glow, particle, cable, projectile or electrical effect and no new mechanic is needed. Twelve unique images alone do not demonstrate readable action.
priorityOutcomes.proof: All48 native active images and all4 idle images, measured evaluated motion/ground sweep, four frame13 closure checks and all-four intended-size playback. Actual consumer shows the assembled neutral native sprite and separate equipment/eel sprites; it does not overlay standalone collectors to simulate integration. Review390px phone and768px wider captures, all12 phases on phone and representative extrema/phase boundaries wider.
